combine.description: Combine all input sources into a single source (--combine)

limit.description: Exit after this number of iterations (--limit)

speedonly.description: Don't print graphs, print speed only (--speedonly)

filename.description: Print filename headings before the stats (--filename)

noclear.description: Do not clear the screen between prints (--noclear)

raw.description: Treat input lines as values to add to counter (--raw)

files.description: List of log files or paths to monitor. Use '-' for stdin.
